# controld_filter (Resource)

Enables or disables a native ControlD filter list (e.g. malware, ads) for a profile. Filters are predefined by ControlD (see the `controld_native_filters` data source for the full catalog); deleting this resource disables the filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "controld_filter" "malware" {
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
  filter     = "malware"
  status     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (String) The filter identifier (PK), as returned by the `controld_native_filters` data source.
- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile this filter belongs to.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the filter is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource, in the form `profile_id/filter`.
